title: [Fate's Holding, Entry]
description: Blotting out the twilight-hued sky with its overlapping canopy, a dense forest of deciduous and coniferous trees surrounds a twining pathway that departs from a spear-topped black iron gate and disappears into the darkness.  Flickering lights dance through the dense undergrowth, their colors ranging in hue from amber to chartreuse and violet to corral.  A wooden sign sits at an angle to the ground, its face turned to ribbons of light that bleed through the bars of the gate.
